summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a declared cash dividend of $0.17 per share, totaling approximately $9.8 million, payable September 17, 2026 to shareholders of record August 27, 2026. The dividend is consistent with the company's dividend policy, reflecting record-high first-half 2026 results and solid cash position. CEO Amir London commented, emphasizing continued investment in growth and M&A while returning capital. Tax withholding will follow Israeli tax law; a ruling from the Israel Tax Authority is sought for non-Israeli shareholders. Control remains with FIMI Opportunity Funds (38% stake). Watch for continued quarterly dividend cadence and potential M&A deployment.
